note: Every model this pipeline calls, declared once. The same three identifiers were previously written into five modules, so a provider or revision change meant finding all of them and the run manifests recorded whichever copy happened to be read.

exact-text-embedding.name: gemini-embedding-001
exact-text-embedding.note: min_seconds_per_batch keeps a 100-item batch under the paid-tier per-minute ceiling rather than discovering it by being throttled.

occurrence-pos.name: es_dep_news_trf
occurrence-pos.note: Spanish. Pinned and enforced at load: a run must not record a revision it did not verify.

token-context.name: dccuchile/bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased
token-context.note: BETO, used by the lyrics token-tuple vote.

occurrence-pos-pt.name: pt_core_news_lg
occurrence-pos-pt.note: Portuguese. Verified to tag `do`/`ao` as ADP, `a` as DET and `é` as AUX -- none of which Wiktionary publishes under those names, which is why the wiktionary POS bridge is required before any filtering.

occurrence-pos-fr.name: fr_core_news_lg
occurrence-pos-fr.note: French. Elision splits a token (n', j'), so a surface span may not align with a whole word the way it does in Spanish or Portuguese.
